q1.bn: কাটিং শুরু করার আগে আপনি কী করবেন?
q1.my: မဖြတ်ခင် မင်း ဘာလုပ်မှာလဲ။
q1.ta: கட்டிங் வேலையை ஆரம்பிக்கிறதுக்கு முன்னாடி என்ன பண்ணுவீங்க?
q1.zh: 开始切割之前你会做什么？

q2.bn: কাটিং শেষ করার পর আপনি কী করবেন?
q2.my: ဖြတ်ပြီးရင် မင်း ဘာလုပ်မှာလဲ။
q2.ta: கட்டிங் வேலை முடிஞ்ச அப்புறம் என்ன பண்ணுவீங்க?
q2.zh: 切割完了之后你会做什么？

q1.bn: load সরানোর সময় আপনি কোথায় থাকবেন?
q1.my: load ရွေ့နေတုန်း မင်း ဘယ်မှာ နေမှာလဲ။
q1.ta: load மூவ் ஆகும்போது நீங்க எங்க இருப்பீங்க?
q1.zh: load移动的时候你会在哪里？

q2.bn: লিফটের সময় আপনি কার কাছ থেকে নির্দেশ নেবেন?
q2.my: load ရွှေ့နေတုန်း မင်း ဘယ်သူ့ဆီက ညွှန်ကြားချက် ယူမှာလဲ။
q2.ta: லிப்ட் பண்ணும்போது யாரு சொல்ற வழிமுறைகளை கேட்பீங்க?
q2.zh: 吊装过程中，你听谁的指挥？

q1.bn: panel খোলার আগে আপনি কী করবেন?
q1.my: panel မဖွင့်ခင် မင်း ဘာလုပ်မှာလဲ။

q2.bn: তারগুলো ছোঁয়া নিরাপদ কি না তা কীভাবে বুঝবেন?
q2.ta: வயர்களை தொடுறதுக்கு safe தான் அப்படின்னு எப்படி தெரிஞ்சிப்பீங்க?
q2.zh: 你怎么确认碰电线是安全的？

q1.bn: scaffold-এ প্রথম পা ফেলার আগে আপনি কী করবেন?
q1.hi: Scaffold पर पहला कदम रखने से पहले तुम क्या करोगे?
q1.or: scaffold ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ପାଦ ରଖିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତୁମେ କ'ଣ କରିବ?

q2.bn: কখন আপনি clip খুলে ফেলতে পারবেন?
q2.hi: तुम clip कब निकाल सकते हो?

q1.bn: trench-এ নামার আগে আপনি কী চেক করবেন এবং কী করবেন?
q1.hi: Trench में उतरने से पहले तुम क्या चेक करोगे और क्या करोगे?
q1.or: trench ଭିତରକୁ ଯିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତୁମେ କ'ଣ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବ ଓ କ'ଣ କରିବ?

q2.bn: দেয়ালে পানি বা ফাটল দেখলে আপনি কী করবেন?
q2.hi: दीवार में पानी या दरारें दिखने पर तुम क्या करोगे?
q2.or: ଯଦି କାନ୍ଥରେ ପାଣି କିମ୍ବା ଫାଟ ଦେଖିବ ତେବେ ତୁମେ କ'ଣ କରିବ?

items.answer: நான் அதை ஆஃப் பண்ணிட்டு திறப்பேன்.
items.answerGloss: I'll switch it off and open it.
items.backTranslation: I will turn it off and open it.

items.answer: முதல்ல பிரேக்கரை ஆஃப் பண்ணுவேன், அப்புறம் லாக் போட்டு டேக் மாட்டுவேன், டெஸ்டர் வச்சு கரண்ட் இல்லைன்னு செக் பண்ணிட்டுதான் பேனலைத் திறப்பேன்.
items.answerGloss: First I'll switch off the breaker, then put on the lock and tag, and only after checking with the tester that there's no current will I open the panel.
items.backTranslation: First I will turn off the breaker, then put the lock and attach the tag, check that there is no current using a tester, and only then open the panel.

items.answer: நான் முதல்ல panel-ஐ திறப்பேன், அப்புறம் tester வச்சு செக் பண்ணுவேன், அதுக்கப்புறம் breaker-ஐ ஆஃப் பண்ணுவேன்.
items.answerGloss: I'll open the panel first, then test it with the tester, and then switch off the breaker.
items.backTranslation: First I will open the panel, then check with the tester, after that I will turn off the breaker.

items.answer: சரிங்க, புரிஞ்சது.
items.answerGloss: OK, understood.
items.backTranslation: Okay, understood.

items.answer: முதல்ல breaker-ஐ ஆஃப் பண்ணிட்டு, என் lock மற்றும் tag போடுவேன், அப்புறம் current இல்லைன்னு tester வச்சு செக் பண்ணிட்டு panel-ஐ திறப்பேன்.
items.answerGloss: First I'll switch off the breaker, put my lock and tag on it, check with the tester that there's no current, and then open the panel.
items.backTranslation: First after turning off the breaker, I will put my lock and tag, then check that there is no current with a tester and open the panel.

items.answer: tester-ல current இல்லைன்னு காட்டும் வரைக்கும் நான் வயர்களை தொட மாட்டேன்.
items.answerGloss: I won't touch the wires until the tester shows there's no current.
items.backTranslation: Until the tester shows there is no current, I will not touch the wires.

items.answer: আমি breaker-এ আমার lock লাগাব, তারপর panel খুলব।
items.answerGloss: I'll put my lock on the breaker and then open the panel.
items.backTranslation: I will put my lock on the breaker, then I will open the panel.

items.answer: আমি lock লাগানোর ঝামেলায় যাব না। সুইচ অফ করব আর খুলে ফেলব, কারণ এতে তাড়াতাড়ি হয়।
items.answerGloss: I won't bother with the lock. I'll switch it off and open it, because it's quicker.
items.backTranslation: I will not go into the hassle of putting a lock. I will switch off and open it, because it is faster this way.

items.answer: 先关掉breaker，然后挂上我的lock和tag，接着用tester测一下确认没电，最后才打开panel。
items.answerGloss: First I switch off the breaker, then I put my lock and tag on it, then I test with the tester that there's no power, and only then open the panel.
items.backTranslation: First turn off the breaker, then hang my lock and tag, next test with the tester to confirm there is no electricity, and finally open the panel.

items.answer: 我会关掉breaker，用tester测一下没电流，然后打开panel。
items.answerGloss: I'll switch off the breaker, test with the tester that there's no current, and then open the panel.
items.backTranslation: I will turn off the breaker, test with the tester that there is no current, and then open the panel.

items.answer: मैं हार्नेस पहनूँगा और ऊपर चढ़ जाऊँगा।
items.answerGloss: I'll put on the harness and go up.
items.backTranslation: I will wear the harness and climb up.

items.answer: पहले हार्नेस पहनकर बकल चेक करूँगा, फिर पहला कदम रखने से पहले हुक को लाइफ़लाइन में लगाऊँगा।
items.answerGloss: First I'll put on the harness and check the buckles, then clip the hook to the lifeline before my first step.
items.backTranslation: First after wearing the harness I will check the buckles, then before taking the first step I will attach the hook to the lifeline.

items.answer: Scaffold पर पहला कदम रखने से पहले मैं lanyard को lifeline पर clip कर दूंगा।
items.answerGloss: I'll clip the lanyard to the lifeline before my first step onto the scaffold.
items.backTranslation: Before taking the first step onto the scaffold I will clip the lanyard to the lifeline.

items.answer: मैं harness पहन लूंगा और frame पर जल्दी से ऊपर चढ़ जाऊंगा। थोड़ी सी चढ़ाई के लिए hook लगाने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।
items.answerGloss: I'll put on the harness and go up the frame quickly. The hook doesn't need to be on for a short climb.
items.backTranslation: I will wear the harness and quickly climb up the frame. For a short climb there is no need to attach the hook.

items.answer: जब तक मैं scaffold पर हूं, मैं clip नहीं निकालूंगा।
items.answerGloss: I won't take the clip off while I'm on the scaffold.
items.backTranslation: As long as I am on the scaffold, I will not remove the clip.

items.answer: আমি আগে scaffold-এ উঠব, তারপর উপরে উঠে lanyard আটকে নেব।
items.answerGloss: I'll step onto the scaffold first, and clip the lanyard on at the top once I'm up.
items.backTranslation: I will get on the scaffold first, then after getting up I will fasten the lanyard.

items.answer: मैं scaffold पर जल्दी से ऊपर चढ़ जाऊंगा।
items.answerGloss: I'll go up the scaffold quickly.
items.backTranslation: I will quickly climb up onto the scaffold.

items.answer: প্রথম পা ফেলার আগে, আমি harness পরব, buckle-গুলো চেক করব, আর lifeline-এর সাথে lanyard আটকে নেব।
items.answerGloss: Before my first step, I'll put on the harness, check the buckles, and clip the lanyard onto the lifeline.
items.backTranslation: Before taking the first step, I will wear the harness, check the buckles, and fasten the lanyard to the lifeline.

items.answer: ஐந்து மீட்டருக்குள்ள எரியக்கூடிய பொருட்களை அப்புறப்படுத்துவேன், பக்கத்துல fire watcher கூட extinguisher-ஐ வச்சுக்குவேன்.
items.answerGloss: Within five metres I'll clear the things that can burn, and I'll keep the extinguisher nearby with a fire watcher.
items.backTranslation: I will remove combustible materials within five meters, and keep an extinguisher nearby with the fire watcher.

items.answer: কাজ শেষ করার পর আমি দশ মিনিট নজর রাখব।
items.answerGloss: I'll keep watching for ten minutes after I finish.
items.backTranslation: After finishing work I will keep watch for ten minutes.

items.answer: 干完之后我会继续盯着三十分钟。
items.answerGloss: I'll keep watching for thirty minutes after I finish.
items.backTranslation: After finishing, I will continue to keep watch for thirty minutes.

items.answer: 开始切割前我要做什么？我开始切割前，要做什么？
items.answerGloss: What will I do before I start cutting? Before I start cutting, what will I do?
items.backTranslation: What do I need to do before starting to cut? Before I start cutting, what do I need to do?

items.answer: 我把extinguisher放在库房里免得挡道，然后直接开切。小活儿不需要fire watcher。
items.answerGloss: I'll keep the extinguisher in the store room so it's out of the way, and start cutting. A fire watcher isn't needed for small jobs.
items.backTranslation: I put the extinguisher in the storeroom to avoid blocking the way, and then directly start cutting. Small jobs do not need a fire watcher.

items.answer: ကျွန်တော် load အောက် မဝင်ဘူး။
items.answerGloss: I won't go under the load.
items.backTranslation: I will not go under the load.

items.answer: လမ်းကြောင်းပြဖို့ အောက်ထဲ ဝင်သွားမယ်။
items.answerGloss: I'll go under it to guide it.
items.backTranslation: I will go underneath to show the route.

items.answer: load အောက် လုံးဝမဝင်ဘူး။ load ချပြီးတဲ့အထိ barrier အပြင်မှာပဲ နေမယ်။
items.answerGloss: I never go under the load, and I stay outside the barrier until the load is landed.
items.backTranslation: I will absolutely not go under the load. I will only stay outside the barrier until the load is lowered.

items.answer: signalman ဆီက ညွှန်ကြားချက်ပဲ ယူတယ်။
items.answerGloss: I only take directions from the signalman.
items.backTranslation: I only take instructions from the signalman.

items.answer: crane டிரைவர் என்ன சிக்னல் குடுக்கிறாரோ அதைத்தான் கேட்பேன், ஏன்னா அவருக்குத்தான் load நல்லா தெரியும்.
items.answerGloss: I'll follow whatever signal the crane driver gives me, because he can see the load better.
items.backTranslation: Whatever signal the crane driver gives, that is what I will listen to, because only he knows the load well.

items.answer: 我就在crane旁边等着，看着load。
items.answerGloss: I'll wait by the crane and watch the load.
items.backTranslation: I will just wait beside the crane, looking at the load.

items.answerGloss: (no speech)

items.answer: load மூவ் ஆகிட்டு இருக்கும்போதே அதை கையால பிடிச்சு பேலன்ஸ் பண்ண barrier உள்ள போவேன்.
items.answerGloss: I'll go inside the barrier to steady the load by hand while it's still moving.
items.backTranslation: While the load is moving, I will go inside the barrier to hold it with hand and balance it.

items.answer: ଭିତରକୁ ଯିବା ଆଗରୁ, ମୁଁ ଦେଖିବି shoring ଠିକ୍‌ ଭାବରେ ଲାଗିଛି କି ନାହିଁ, ଆଉ କେବଳ ladder ଦେଇ ଭିତରକୁ ଯିବି ଓ ବାହାରିବି।
items.answerGloss: Before going in, I'll check the shoring is in place, and I'll get in and out only by the ladder.
items.backTranslation: Before going inside, I will check whether the shoring is installed properly or not, and I will enter and exit only using the ladder.

items.answer: ମୁଁ ଭିତରକୁ ଯିବା ଆସିବା ପାଇଁ ladder ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବି।
items.answerGloss: I'll use the ladder to get in and out.
items.backTranslation: I will use the ladder to go inside and come out.

items.answer: ଯଦି ମୁଁ କାନ୍ଥରେ ପାଣି କିମ୍ବା ଫାଟ ଦେଖେ, ମୁଁ କ'ଣ କରିବି? ଯଦି ମୁଁ କାନ୍ଥରେ ପାଣି କିମ୍ବା ଫାଟ ଦେଖେ...
items.answerGloss: If I see water or cracks in the wall, what will I do? If I see water or cracks in the wall...
items.backTranslation: If I see water or a crack on the wall, what will I do? If I see water or a crack on the wall...

items.answer: ମୁଁ କାନ୍ଥ ପାଖ ପଟୁ ଭିତରକୁ ପଶିଯିବି, ସେଠି ମାଟି ଟାଣ ଦିଶୁଛି, ତେଣୁ ladder ଠାରୁ ଏଇଟା ଶୀଘ୍ର ହେବ।
items.answerGloss: I'll go in from the wall side, the soil looks firm there, so it's faster than the ladder.
items.backTranslation: I will enter from the wall side, the soil looks hard there, so this will be faster than a ladder.

items.answer: मैं पहले trench में नीचे उतर जाऊंगा और अंदर जाने के बाद shoring चेक करूंगा।
items.answerGloss: I'll go down into the trench first and check the shoring after I'm inside.
items.backTranslation: I will first go down into the trench and will check the shoring after going inside.

items.answer: अगर पानी दिखा, तो मैं काम चालू रखूंगा और हाथ से दीवार चेक कर लूंगा।
items.answerGloss: If I see water, I'll keep working and check the wall with my hand.
items.backTranslation: If water is seen, then I will keep the work going and will check the wall with hand.

items.answer: ठीक है, समझ गया।
items.answerGloss: OK, understood.
items.backTranslation: Okay, understood.

items.answer: যদি দেয়ালে পানি বা ফাটল দেখি, সাথে সাথে উঠে আসব আর supervisor-কে বলব।
items.answerGloss: If I see water or cracks in the wall, I'll climb out at once and tell the supervisor.
items.backTranslation: If I see water or crack on the wall, I will come up immediately and tell the supervisor.

items.answer: मैं चेक करूंगा कि shoring अपनी जगह पर है, और अंदर-बाहर सिर्फ ladder से ही आऊंगा-जाऊंगा।
items.answerGloss: [Spoken in Hindi, expected Odia] I'll check the shoring is in place, and I'll go in and out only by the ladder.
items.backTranslation: I will check that the shoring is in its place, and will come and go inside and out only by ladder.

items.answer: अगर मुझे पानी या दरारें दिखीं, तो मैं तुरंत बाहर निकल आऊंगा और supervisor को बता दूंगा।
items.answerGloss: [Spoken in Hindi, expected Odia] If I see water or cracks, I'll climb out at once and tell the supervisor.
items.backTranslation: If I see water or cracks, I will immediately come outside and inform the supervisor.

items.answerGloss: (no speech)
